user.title: DynTarNL — choose your supplier
user.description: Choose your energy supplier. The integration figures out which platform and price API to use. Supplier not listed? Choose 'Custom supplier (manual)'.

custom.title: Custom supplier
custom.description:
Useful for suppliers without a public API, such as Vattenfall, Eneco, Tibber, Greenchoice, Zonneplan, ENGIE, DELTA, Vandebron, OXXIO and others.

The integration fetches the bare EPEX market price and computes the all-in price itself. Enter your tariffs excluding VAT; VAT is applied on top.

all-in = (EPEX + markup + energy tax) × (1 + VAT%)

data_description.epex_source: Where the bare market price comes from. For electricity it is identical everywhere; for gas it differs slightly per source. Unsure? Leave easyEnergy.

reconfigure.title: Change supplier
reconfigure.description: Choose a different energy supplier, or 'Custom supplier (manual)' to change your own tariffs. Your entities, history and forecast settings are kept.

abort.single_instance_allowed: DynTarNL is already set up. Change the supplier via ⋮ → Reconfigure.

refresh.name: Refresh tariffs
refresh.description: Fetches the dynamic tariffs again right away (and the price forecasts, when enabled).

get_prices.name: Get prices
get_prices.description: Returns the full price series (published prices, optionally extended with forecasts) as response data. Electricity per quarter hour, gas per gas day.

energy.name: Energy
energy.description: electricity or gas (gas: published prices only).

include_forecast.name: Include forecast
include_forecast.description: Extend with forecasts (only when the forecast option is on).

provider.name: Source
provider.description: ensemble (default), a single source (epexpredictor, energypriceforecast) or all (also returns each source series separately).

horizon.name: Horizon
horizon.description: Only quarters up to this many hours from now.

format.name: Format
format.description: records = per quarter hour (as before); table = the compact buy and sell table, exactly like the table entities.

forecast.title: Forecast settings
forecast.description: Forecasts are always fetched as the bare EPEX price; your supplier's formula (markup, energy tax, VAT) is applied by DynTarNL. Published prices always win over forecasts.

data_description.forecast_ensemble: Off = only the separate source series; sensors then use the first source in the list that has a value.
data_description.forecast_weighting: Automatic = sources that turned out more accurate weigh more. Requires accuracy measurement.
data_description.forecast_accuracy: Compares every forecast with the price that is published later. Needed for automatic weighting and the expected error.
data_description.forecast_horizon_hours: Energy Price Forecast EU delivers at most 48 h without an API key (120 h with one); EpexPredictor about 7 days.
data_description.forecast_interval_hours: How often each source is asked. These are free services: a few times a day is plenty.

provider_settings.title: Source settings
provider_settings.description:
Settings per selected source. A changed URL or key is checked with one test call.

Energy Price Forecast EU: 48 hours without a key, 120 hours with a [Private Pro]({private_pro_url}) key. Private, non-commercial use only.

data.forecast_energypriceforecast_api_key: Energy Price Forecast EU API key (optional)

data_description.forecast_epexpredictor_url: Public instance or your own (e.g. a local container or add-on).
data_description.forecast_energypriceforecast_api_key: Without a key the horizon is at most 48 hours.

data_description.forecast_min_samples: Until every source has this many settled quarters, all sources weigh the same (96 = one day).
data_description.forecast_weight_floor: Share (0–0.5) a source always keeps, so it can earn back its weight after a bad period.
data_description.forecast_bias_correction: Subtract each source's measured systematic error before averaging.
data_description.forecast_window_days: Accuracy is measured over this many most recent days.
data_description.forecast_cheapest_hours: Used by the 'cheapest block start' sensor (next 48 hours, forecasts included).

forecast_switch.title: Price forecasts
forecast_switch.description: Optionally extend the published day-ahead prices with EPEX price forecasts up to 7 days ahead. DynTarNL does not forecast itself: it reads the forecasts of external forecasters, averages them (weighted by measured accuracy) and converts them with your supplier's tariffs. Off by default: when off, nothing changes (no extra API calls, no extra entities).

tariffs.title: Tariff periods
tariffs.description: Each period applies from its start date (00:00) until the next one. Every time slot uses the rules of its own period, also in forecasts. Saving reloads DynTarNL (no restart).

period_delete.title: Delete a period
period_delete.description: Choose the period to delete. The earliest period must start today or earlier.

data_description.start: Applies from 00:00 (Europe/Amsterdam) on this date until the next period starts.
data_description.contract: Dynamic follows the market price per time slot; fixed/variable uses your contract rates.
data_description.netting: On until 31-12-2026: feed-in is worth exactly the purchase price of the same time slot. Off from 2027.
data_description.provisional: Mark values that are not final yet (e.g. Belastingplan). You get a repair notice 14 days before the start.
data_description.note: Free text, e.g. where the values come from.

period_details_dynamic.title: Dynamic contract
period_details_dynamic.description: Purchase and feed-in for this period. Leave a field empty if unknown: slots then get no price (never 0).

data_description.markup_elec_ex: €/kWh. With a supplier that publishes its own prices (Essent, Frank, …) only used for forecast hours in this period; empty = the supplier's current markup.

sell.name: Feed-in
sell.description: What you get per exported kWh. Ignored while netting is on (then feed-in = purchase).

data_description.export_markup_ex: €/kWh on top of the bare market price. May be negative. Only without netting.
data_description.export_costs_ex: €/kWh deducted from every exported kWh. Only without netting.
data_description.export_costs_year: Information only (e.g. a bracket/staffel); not part of the kWh price.

period_details_fixed.title: Fixed / variable contract
period_details_fixed.description: Purchase and feed-in for this period. Variable = a fixed contract whose rate changes: add a new period per change.

data_description.rate_input: All-in = incl. energy tax and VAT (as on your contract); bare = supply rate excl. VAT, DynTarNL adds energy tax and VAT.
data_description.rate_gas: €/m³, as chosen above. Empty = no gas price.
data_description.low_holidays: New Year, Easter, King's Day, Ascension, Whitsun, Christmas (check with your grid operator).
data_description.fixed_costs_month: Information only; not part of the kWh price.

sell.name: Feed-in
sell.description: What you get per exported kWh. Ignored while netting is on (then feed-in = purchase).

data_description.export_rate_ex: €/kWh, bare (no energy tax, no VAT). Only without netting.
data_description.export_costs_ex: €/kWh deducted from every exported kWh. Only without netting.
data_description.export_costs_year: Information only (e.g. a bracket/staffel); not part of the kWh price.

error.weighting_needs_accuracy: Automatic weighting needs accuracy measurement turned on.
error.duplicate_start: A period with this start date already exists.
error.gap_before_first: The earliest period must start today or earlier (no gap before the first period).
error.last_period: The last period cannot be deleted.
error.missing_fields: Required values are missing: {missing}. Fill them in, or mark the period as provisional.
error.invalid_period: These values do not form a valid period.

period_incomplete.title: Tariff period {start} is provisional or incomplete
period_incomplete.description:
The DynTarNL tariff period starting {start} applies now or within 14 days, but is marked provisional ({provisional}) or misses values: {missing}.

Time slots without a value get no price (unknown), never 0. Check the values (e.g. the final Belastingplan and your supplier's new conditions) via Settings → Devices & services → DynTarNL → Configure → Tariff periods, and clear the "provisional" flag.

export_below_minimum.title: Feed-in compensation below the legal minimum ({start})
export_below_minimum.description: In the tariff period starting {start} the configured feed-in compensation is lower than 50% of the bare supply rate. From 2027 to 2029 suppliers must pay at least that. Check the value with your contract.

legacy_export_entities.title: Old feed-in entities will be replaced in DynTarNL 2.0
